records.real_world_identity_notes: Reiza's renamed Ferrari 550 Maranello: the GT1 car Prodrive built for Care Racing Development, which raced the FIA GT Championship from 2001 to 2005 and Le Mans through 2006. AMS2 carries it as Milano 55 GT1. The record previously treated the renaming as a fictional car and declined to name an analogue; the maintainer identified it. A six-speed Xtrac sequential and a 600 bhp V12 agree with the six sequential gears and the automatic cut found in the drive, the cut being the car's flat-shift facility worked by an optical sensor at the base of the gearlever.
